transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… I’m here because I’m tired all the time. At work, even by midmorning, after just going through files or helping a junior adjuster with a claim, I feel like I’m already running on empty. My body and my head both.
How long have you been feeling this tiredness?

About… a little over three years. Maybe three years and a few months. It started after I got moved into that higher-responsibility role, mentoring the adjusters and dealing with the new workflow systems.
Have you been feeling sad or down most of the time since you started feeling tired?

Yeah… most days, I think. It’s not always like crying or anything. It’s more like everything has this gray film over it. Even when my husband’s being kind, or we’re cooking with the family, I can go through it all… but I don’t really feel the enjoyment like I used to.
Do you find yourself losing interest in activities that you used to enjoy?

Yeah… I have. I used to paint, and go hiking, and I volunteered sometimes. Lately I’ve mostly stopped. I just feel like I’m trying to get through the week. Even at work, I’m slower signing off on files and I’ve missed details in audits, so by the time I’m done, there’s not much left in me.
Have you been feeling anxious or worried a lot lately?
I don’t know… not a lot, I guess. I worry about things like anyone does, but I wouldn’t say that’s the main thing I’ve noticed.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight since you started feeling this way?
Not really… I mean, nothing significant that I’ve noticed. My clothes seem about the same, I think.
Have you been having trouble sleeping?
I’m not really sure… I mean, some nights aren’t great, but I haven’t been keeping track or anything.
Have you had periods in the past where you felt better, and then the tiredness and sadness came back?

Maybe a little here and there, but it mostly just… keeps coming back. It’s been about three years now—three years and a few months, I guess—since I got moved into that higher-responsibility role, mentoring adjusters and dealing with the new workflow systems. Since then it hasn’t really let up for long.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from activities that normally would bring you happiness?

Yeah… I guess so. It’s like most days there’s this gray film over everything. Even when my husband’s being kind, or we’re cooking with the family, I can do it, but I don’t really feel the enjoyment like I used to.
How long have you been feeling this way without any significant improvement?

It’s been… about three years and a few months. Since I got moved into that higher-responsibility role, mentoring adjusters and dealing with the new workflow systems. It hasn’t really improved much since then.
Have you had any periods where your symptoms completely went away for at least two months?
No… not for that long. It’s been going on about three years and a few months, since that higher-responsibility role started, and I don’t think it’s ever really cleared for two months.
Have your feelings of tiredness and sadness been present for most of the day, nearly every day, since they started?

Yes… most days, pretty much. It’s been like that since I got put into that higher-responsibility role, mentoring adjusters and handling the new workflow systems… about three years and three months ago.
Have your feelings of tiredness and sadness been going on for at least two years?
Yes… it’s been more than two years. About three years and three months, since I was moved into that higher-responsibility role.
Have your feelings of tiredness and sadness been continuous, without any periods where you felt completely better for at least two months, since they first started about three years ago?
Yes… it’s been pretty continuous. About three years and three months now, since I was moved into that higher-responsibility role with mentoring adjusters and the workflow systems.
Have you had any periods where you felt completely back to your normal self for at least two months since your symptoms started?
No… not really. I haven’t felt fully back to normal for any two-month stretch. It’s just been going on since that role change, about three years and three months ago.
Have your symptoms been present for the majority of every day?

Most days, yes. It’s there for a lot of the day… I came in because I’m just tired all the time. Even by midmorning at work, after reviewing files or helping a junior adjuster with a claim, I already feel like I’m running on empty.
Have your feelings of tiredness and sadness been present for at least two years without any significant breaks?
Yes… it’s been a little over three years now. About three years and three months, since I was moved into that higher-responsibility role with mentoring adjusters and the workflow systems.
Have your symptoms lasted without any significant improvement for the past two years or more?
Yes… it’s been more than two years. Around three years and a few months now, since I got moved into that higher-responsibility role with mentoring people and the new workflow systems.
Have your symptoms been present without any significant improvement for the past two years or more, making it a persistent feeling?
Yes… it’s been persistent. About three years and three months, since I was moved into that higher-responsibility role with mentoring adjusters and the new workflow systems.
Have you had any episodes where you felt completely better for at least two months since your symptoms started?
No… I don’t think I’ve had a stretch like that. It’s just kind of been there since that job change, about three years and three months ago.
